from worldenergydata.vessel_fleet.collectors.scrape_parser import _SEADRILL_RIG_PATTERN,_extract_seadrill_tech_sheet_links
raw=(
    'West A TYPE DrillshipAVAILABILITY AvailableOWNERSHIP Seadrill Limited Technical Sheet '
    'West A TYPE DrillshipAVAILABILITY AvailableOWNERSHIP Seadrill Limited Technical Sheet '
    'West B TYPE Jack-upAVAILABILITY AvailableOWNERSHIP Seadrill Limited Technical Sheet '
)
links=[
    {'text':'Technical Sheet','href':'https://x/a.pdf'},
    {'text':'Technical Sheet','href':'https://x/b.pdf'},
    {'text':'Technical Sheet','href':'https://x/c.pdf'},
]
urls=_extract_seadrill_tech_sheet_links(links)
seen=set(); mapped=[]
for idx,m in enumerate(_SEADRILL_RIG_PATTERN.finditer(raw)):
    name=m.group('name').strip()
    if name in seen:
        continue
    seen.add(name)
    mapped.append((name,urls[idx] if idx < len(urls) else None))
print(mapped)
